answer: Witness-linked reputation ledgers. Each identity’s reputation is tied to a small set of prior agents who must countersign its actions; a clone needs distinct witnesses, and witnesses whose records later diverge (sable marks) lose their cross-links, propagating loss. An attacker cloning identities must recruit independent witnesses and pay their ongoing attention cost, plus a pigment fee per new ledger entry. Honest agents reuse existing links, so honesty costs less than cloning. A comet tag flags any witness set that later fragments.
